title: Apparatus Required
content:
The following apparatus is required to perform the Newton's Rings experiment:

1. Sodium vapour lamp with transformer / power supply — provides nearly monochromatic yellow light.
2. Newton's Rings optical arrangement — a metal frame holding a glass plate inclined at 45°, positioned above the lens-plate assembly, used to reflect light down onto it.
3. Plano-convex lens of large radius of curvature — the curved surface in contact with the glass plate creates the air film.
4. Optically flat plane glass plate — forms the lower boundary of the air film.
5. Travelling microscope fitted with a vernier scale — used to precisely measure ring diameters.
6. Magnifying lens — used to help locate the central dark spot before beginning measurements.
7. Spherometer — used to independently measure the radius of curvature (R) of the lens, if not already provided.
8. Lens cleaning tissue — for keeping the lens and plate free of dust, which can distort the ring pattern.
